concept.title: Food parcels and take-home food
concept.shortdesc: Receiving free or low-cost food to take home, such as food parcels, boxes or bags, or choosing items from a larder or community food shop.

keywords.keyword: where can I get a food parcel
help with food shopping when money is tight

conbody.note: Draft category. The name and definition were written by a language model from a clustering of real service descriptions, and no person has reviewed them.

ul.li: bag of food for a small fee

cooked meals prepared for you: see (meals rather than groceries to take home)
collecting surplus food from shops and farms: belongs in a neighbouring group that is not yet a category (gathering food for redistribution, not receiving it)
